active_cases.external_contract: Transparent music time labels must remain readable over a dark target window without painting a toolbar backdrop.
active_cases.expected_output: Each time label has at least 20 rendered pixels with contrast >= 4.5:1 against the dark target background.
active_cases.reproduction_command: mkdir -p .build/tests && xcrun swiftc source/Localization.swift source/WindowPolicy.swift source/MusicPlayer.swift source/MusicPlaylist.swift source/MusicWindow.swift tests/regression/music-control-contrast/active/REG-001.swift -framework AppKit -framework AVFoundation -o .build/tests/music-contrast && .build/tests/music-contrast
active_cases.selected_solution: User selected white foreground with fine dark outlines; retain transparent backdrop and existing window level.

surrounding_verification.playing_demo: Generated WAV, muted output, seek to 35 seconds; 0:35/1:00 labels remain readable on both backdrops.
